lead: The pump stack, in a capsule. L-citrulline and L-arginine work together to boost nitric oxide — widening blood vessels for bigger pumps, better blood flow and faster post-workout recovery. No giant pre-workout scoop required.
note: 30 servings · 60 vegan capsules · ships in 1–2 days

science.title: Two routes to better pumps
science.text: Nitric oxide tells your blood vessels to relax and widen — more flow, more oxygen and nutrients to working muscles, and that skin-tight pump. We stack L-citrulline (which your body converts into arginine, the most reliable way to raise NO) with L-arginine itself and AAKG, so you hit the nitric-oxide pathway from two directions for better pumps, endurance and recovery.

format.title: Pre-workout pumps, no scoop
format.text: All the blood-flow benefits of a citrulline-arginine pre-workout, without the giant tub or the jittery stimulants — just two clean vegan capsules.

absorb.title: Open up the blood flow
absorb.lead: Citrulline and arginine raise nitric oxide, relaxing blood vessels so more blood, oxygen and nutrients reach your muscles — during and after training.

points.title: L-citrulline malate
points.text: Converted into arginine in the body — actually a more effective way to raise nitric oxide than arginine alone.

points.title: L-arginine + AAKG
points.text: Direct arginine plus alpha-ketoglutarate to feed the nitric-oxide pathway and support blood flow.

points.title: Pump & recovery
points.text: Better circulation means bigger pumps in the gym and faster clearing of waste for recovery after.

ingredients.title: A focused NO stack
ingredients.lead: Citrulline and two forms of arginine for nitric oxide and blood flow.*

items.name: L-Citrulline Malate
items.text: Converts into arginine in the body for a sustained rise in nitric oxide — plus malate to support energy and reduce fatigue.

items.name: L-Arginine HCl
items.text: A direct source of arginine, the amino acid your body uses to produce nitric oxide for blood flow and pumps.

items.name: L-Arginine AKG
items.text: Arginine bound to alpha-ketoglutarate — a popular form in pump formulas to support nitric oxide and circulation.

facts.other: Other Ingredients: Cellulose (vegetable capsule), Brown Rice Flour.
facts.side_text: 400 mg L-citrulline DL-malate plus 400 mg of arginine (350 mg HCl + 50 mg AAKG) in a vegan vegetable capsule — no stimulants, no fillers beyond the capsule. Made in the USA — 60 capsules.
facts.warning: If you are pregnant or nursing, under 18, take blood-pressure or erectile-dysfunction medication, or have a medical condition, consult a physician before use.

steps.title: Two capsules with water
steps.text: Take 2 capsules with 6–8 oz of water.

steps.title: ~30 min before training
steps.text: Take them about 30 minutes before your workout so nitric oxide is up when you start.

steps.title: On an empty stomach
steps.text: Amino acids absorb best on a relatively empty stomach — ideal between meals or before eating.

series.label: Pump
series.title: Fuller, harder pumps
series.text: Citrulline and arginine were associated with bigger, longer-lasting pumps and more vascularity during training.

series.label: Endurance
series.title: Train a little longer
series.text: Better blood flow means more oxygen to muscles — tracking with improved endurance and reps before fatigue.

series.label: Recovery
series.title: Bounce back quicker
series.text: Improved circulation helps clear waste and deliver nutrients — linked with smoother recovery and feeling readier the next day.

items.a: They hit the nitric-oxide pathway from two angles: citrulline reliably raises arginine levels in the blood, while direct arginine and AAKG add more raw material — together they support better pumps and blood flow than either alone.
It's the blood-flow part of a pre-workout — the citrulline-arginine pump stack — without caffeine, sweeteners or a big scoop. Stack it with caffeine if you want stimulation too.
About 30 minutes before training, ideally on a relatively empty stomach so the aminos absorb well.
Yes — it's in a vegetable cellulose capsule with no animal ingredients.
If you're pregnant or nursing, under 18, or take blood-pressure or erectile-dysfunction medication, consult a physician before use, as it affects blood flow.
